now.title: What If...?
now.text: In episode 6, Killmonger exposes Stane as the man who paid for Tony's ambush, and Happy knocks him out as security takes him away.

changes.evidence: What If...? episode 6: after Killmonger saves Tony in Afghanistan, they return to Stark Industries in Killmonger's reality, where he exposes Stane's part in the ambush. The record shows no place, though the app has "Killmonger's world" and uses it for the other episode 6 records.

now.title: What If...?
now.text: In episode 9, he kills T'Challa, Rhodey and Tony and becomes Black Panther. Later he joins the Guardians, only to betray them for Ultron's Stones.
cases: BY-009 The Invasion of Wakanda (What If...?)
BY-011 The Battle for the Multiverse (What If...?)

changes.evidence: The record describes two events. In episode 6, Killmonger kills T'Challa, Rhodes and Tony and becomes Black Panther in his own reality (Killmonger's world; it also shows case BY-009, set on the Wakandan border in that reality). In episode 9, he betrays the Guardians in Ultron's home universe. Only Ultron's world is shown.
